name: Ilza
source: Strong-willed and won't be satisfied until she confirms things herself. However, she's also compassionate, kind, and has a big heart. Her village was burned down by the hostile country of Stahl, causing her to lose her family and friends. She was brought into the mansion when she got lost in Yoiyomori, and she's been living there ever since.
